messages:
alex: deploying exp routing endpoint r3-route to canary (20%) now. flag=exp_route_v3=on. keeping old route as fallback. rolling in us-west-2 :rocket:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: SRE oncall (mia) — elevated error rate detected for /v1/generate in us-west-2 canary. 5xx increase + high tail latency. severity=P2
mia: seeing 502s spiking on the canary hosts. metrics: error rate 18% over baseline, p95 latency 1200ms. killing canary traffic?
sam: oncall, i'm watching logs. looks like new routing is returning truncated payloads and connection resets to downstream tokenizer.
alex: rolling back canary or FF kill? i can flip flag exp_route_v3 off immediately. thoughts?
emi_product: customer impact check: monitoring flagged three active orgs with requests routed to canary. alerting acct owners.
sre_lead: mia please take ownership. page the on-call infra if rollback needs infra touch.
mia: taking. flipping flag in 30s. I'll announce when done.
ops-bot: action queued: feature-flag-toggle exp_route_v3 -> OFF by user mia at 2026-03-15T10:03:05Z
ops-bot: executing toggle...
ops-bot: success: exp_route_v3 is now OFF. change-id cflag-20260315-0913
alex: confirmed in dashboard — canary traffic back to old route. error rate dropping but p95 still high for a minute while caches warm.
sam: posting relevant error excerpt:```
[2026-03-15T10:02:58Z] canary-rt-7 request_id=abc123 status=502 downstream_error=tokenizer-conn-refused
[2026-03-15T10:03:01Z] canary-rt-3 request_id=def456 status=502 downstream_error=broken-pipe
```
mia: running quick smoke against /v1/generate on canary path and fallback — baseline OK now. will keep monitoring 15m.
emi_product: sent customer DM to affected orgs with note: "We've routed you back to stable while we investigate. No action required on your side." they acknowledged.
sre_lead: please create an incident ticket and severity. add labels: release, feature-flag, prompt-routing, canary-failure. assign to alex + sam for RCA.
mia: creating incident: INC-2026-0315-01 — "Canary routing experiment caused 502s, FF kill-switch engaged". linking alert graphs.
alex: quick hypothesis — the r3-route shim introduces upstream keepalive mismatch causing tokenizer connection churn under certain traffic shapes. reproducer attempt in staging started.
sam: i have a reproducer with short-burst concurrency that causes immediate tokenizer reconnects. instrumenting to capture tcpstats.
ops-bot: incident escalated to P2. notification sent to SRE lead and Eng Runtime.
emi_product: brief for customer-facing comms: "We experienced degraded completions for a small subset of customers during a canary rollout of an experimental routing feature. We rolled the flag back and service restored. We'll follow up with root cause and mitigations."
mia: handing off active monitoring to alex (next oncall) in 10m. alex are you taking post-kill investigation?
alex: taking handoff. i'll continue smoke and keep the incident open until RCA ticket is filled.
mia: passing baton — status: FF toggled off, error rate normalizing, customer notifications dispatched, reproducer in progress. handing to alex. :handshake:
ops-bot: oncall-handoff recorded: from mia -> alex at 2026-03-15T10:12:34Z
alex: next steps: 1) gather logs from canary hosts and tokenizer service, 2) run expanded staging tests simulating bursts, 3) evaluate making routing shim resilient (keepalive/retry) or change rollout plan to smaller cohorts.
sre_lead: add an automatic FF safety net: when canary error rate > 5% for 5m, auto-disable the flag. file an ops follow-up.
sam: noted — i'm adding instrumentation PR to capture socket errors and add backpressure metrics. linking in INC ticket.
emi_product: ETA for public update? recommend follow-up postmortem in ~48hrs, send interim note in 2-4 hours if anything changes.
alex: will draft interim post in incidents channel and attach initial RCA notes. target full postmortem in 72hrs.
ops-bot: incident status -> monitoring. severity=P2. incident_state=open.
emi_product: thanks team. please include any customer-impact timestamps in the incident ticket for billing/regression review.
alex: logging exact impacted window: 2026-03-15T10:02:30Z to 2026-03-15T10:03:06Z. approx 36s of canary degradation.
mi a: thanks all — I'll stand down from active pager but available for questions. :v:
